definitions.full: H5179. Nchushta ' נְחֻשְׁתָּא proper name, feminine mother of king Jehoiakin 2Kin 24:8 ; ᵐ5 Νεσθα , A Ναισθα , ᵐ5 L Νεεσθαν .

occurrences.englishText: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
